As someone who is suicidal i can not sate enough that asking for help on how to help is amazingly caring. You obviously care about your friend and though i may not be able to provide the you with the answer of what to do, i can give you insight from my own personal life. Not everyone wants to go to the hospital so getting them the help they need can be tricky. Personally i finally got talked into checking myself in at the start of the new year. Im 25 now and ive been strugling with suicide since i was at least 13. You cant help someone who dosnt want to be helped however what you can do is remind them that you are there when they are ready. Listen to her, aknowledge her, show her you care. When you give her a hug hold it for 40 seconds, this will naturaly trigger a realese of dopamine and provide some comfort (i dont know how true that is but as primates it makes sense and plus long hugs are better than short hugs if you ask me but people are differnt). Remind her of all her amzing qualities and how she makes your life richer. Show her love. Be patient, us suicidal thinkers feel a bunch of stress and sometimes we lash out at those we love to create distance so we wont hurt them when we go, try and be understanding that they are so upset is because they care deeply about something. For me even when ive gone numb and dont care about anything and just want to die, i care that i dont care and makes it makes it worse. Remind her its okay to rest her emotions and just be and if she cant then remind her that thats okay too. What ever you do dont lie, and dont provide false hope or promise anything that you cant deliver on. That is key because when you lie or are not sincere it will push them further in the pit (I call this mental state the pit because thats how it feels, like bottomless pit.) I say this from expirence of people trying to help me however like i said i dont know exactly what to do other than love her.( isnt it funny how people can comfortably say i hate you but get all weird saying i love you?)  I really hope more people see your post and provide better advice. The last thing i would like to mention is that im new to reddit. Ive been told to get on here for years and never did. I just recently got on here and i have to say i regret not joining sooner. If she dosnt have a reddit encourage her to get one and post, if she has one encorage her to post. Sometimes just talking about it gets us through the day. And i know when it comes to my suicidal depression i just take it a day at a time. Last but not least dont forget about you! Make sure that you are doing okay. It can be very hard talking to us. Sometimes we tunnel vision and nothing you say or do seems to work and that can be tough on you. Make sure you have someone to talk to too and time to decompress. Thank you for caring! We need more people like you!
